name: Mysore Sofia Ashtanga Yoga (Kiril Yordanov)
reason: Not a school: the listed site kirilyordanov.com (robots.txt allows us) is his personal teacher site, built in 2019; its home, practice and events pages give no named shala, address or current class timetable in Sofia, and the only event is a past summer camp (24-30 July, with cacao ceremonies and a family-constellations session). A teacher personal site counts only if it runs a named shala with a fixed address, so skipped.
